item.title: 1977 Ford Ranchero GT at No Reserve
item.description: This 1977 Ford Ranchero GT was repainted bronze in 2019, and its brown vinyl upholstery has been redone. Powered by a 351ci V8 linked to a three-speed automatic transmission, the vehicle features Cragar 15″ wheels, front disc brakes, a dual exhaust system, stacked quad headlights and taillights, a spray-in bedliner, and air conditioning. item.title: 14k-Mile 2009 Mazda MX-5 Miata Grand Touring at No Reserve
item.description: This 2009 Mazda MX-5 Miata Grand Touring has been registered in Florida since new and has 14k miles. It is finished in Marble White over Havana Brown leather and is powered by a 2.0-liter inline-four paired with a six-speed automatic transmission. Equipment includes a black convertible soft top, 17" V-spoke alloy wheels, heated seats, a CD stereo, a Bose sound system, and automatic climate control. item.title: 1991 Acura Legend L Coupe at No Reserve
item.description: This 1991 Acura Legend L coupe is powered by a 3.2-liter V6 paired with a four-speed automatic transaxle and was acquired by the seller in 2023. The car shows 147k miles and is finished in Golden Glow Pearl over beige leather. Equipment includes a sunroof, a rear spoiler, 15" five-spoke wheels, a power-adjustable driver's seat, cruise control, air conditioning, and a Sony head unit paired with Kicker speakers. item.title: Fuel-Injected 1957 Pontiac Chieftain Safari 4-Door Wagon 3-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 1957 Pontiac Chieftain Safari four-door station wagon was owned by the same person in southeastern Arizona from 1957 through at least 1972. Its 347ci V8 has been rebuilt and updated with FiTech fuel injection, and the engine is linked with a three-speed manual transmission. The suspension has been lowered, and the gray and white interior has been reupholstered. item.title: 19k-Mile 2016 Buick LaCrosse Premium AWD
item.description: This 2016 Buick LaCrosse Premium was initially sold in Pennsylvania and remained registered with its second owner in Massachusetts until the selling dealer's acquisition in 2026. Now showing 19k miles, the car is finished in Sparkling Silver Metallic over Plum leather and is powered by a 3.6-liter V6 paired with a six-speed automatic transaxle and an all-wheel drive system. item.title: 2026 Michelin Tire Giveaway, Round 1—Pick Your Favorite!
item.description: We're ready to restart one of our favorite BaT traditions for 2026: the monthly Michelin/BFGoodrich Tire Giveaway! Our generous partners at Michelin USA have granted us the ability to give away brand new sets of Michelin, Michelin Classic, and BFGoodrich tires to select BaT auction winners, and we're asking for your help in choosing the first worthy vehicle of the year.

item.description: This 2003 Porsche 911 Turbo coupe remained registered in New Mexico from new until 2023 and was purchased by the current owner in 2024. item.title: 1980 Ferrari 512 BB
item.description: This 1980 Ferrari 512 BB is one of 929 carbureted examples produced between 1976 and 1981. It was repainted in its current metallic green finish in 1995 while under the care of its second owner, with whom it remained until its acquisition by the selling dealer in May 2025.
